snippet.title: Juda // Trailer
snippet.description:
Notice: JUDA is no longer available on the Steam store.

Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/1119910/JUDA/

Juda is an adventure game inspired by the action/adventure games of old. Play as a cute creature named Juda who tries to restore balance to his beautiful world while facing a nefarious foe.

Developed by
 Reky Studios aka @patrickgauthieris
